features.name: BC Talent Program
features.description: A training and skills development program that helps partners learn Business Central and gain certification. The program is designed with multiple mediums and has been game-changing for achieving GP to BC migrations with confidence.

features.name: Cross Skills Program
features.description: A component of the BC Talent program focused on intentional skill development. Participants dedicate time to become proficient with Business Central to serve clients better.
